title: cleome spinosa f. horrida
intro: Cleome spinosa f. horrida, commonly known as Horrid Cleome or Spiny Spider Flower, is a flowering plant species native to Mexico and parts of the southwestern United States. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Cleome spinosa f. horrida include its use in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, such as fever, skin infections, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant have been found to include flavonoids, alkaloids, and other secondary metabolites, although further research is needed to fully understand its chemical composition and potential applications.
